checkpoint_name: English Guided Option Selection Rewrite Review Import

examples.title: Direct choice
examples.customer_turn: So do I choose the $29 option or the $59 option?
examples.final_candidate_response: I mean, if you only need [feature X] and [feature Y], start with $29. If [feature A] matters too, $59 fits better.

examples.title: Fit is unclear
examples.customer_turn: I can see both paths, I am just not sure which one fits me.
examples.final_candidate_response: Based on what you said, $59 sounds stronger if [feature A] saves you time. If not, $29 is the safer start and you can upgrade later.

examples.title: Recommendation request
examples.customer_turn: Which route would you suggest for someone like me?
examples.final_candidate_response: Honestly, like, if your main issue is [customer pain], I would lean $59 because it adds [feature A] and [feature B]. If budget matters more, start $29.

examples.title: Explain the difference
examples.customer_turn: What is the real difference between the $29 option and the $59 option?
examples.final_candidate_response: $29 covers [feature X], [feature Y], and [feature Z]. $59 adds [feature A] and [feature B], so it fits better if you need [customer goal].

examples.title: Decide later
examples.customer_turn: Can I choose later instead of deciding on this call?
examples.final_candidate_response: Yes. I can send the differences in writing and keep both options open for the follow-up.

examples.title: Neither feels right
examples.customer_turn: I'm not sure either is right.
examples.final_candidate_response: I get that, you know, it may just mean we should match the plan to [customer goal] first, then see whether $29 or $59 makes sense.

examples.title: Payment path
examples.customer_turn: If I pick one, can I pay now?
examples.final_candidate_response: No payment on this call. I'll send you the link by email, and you can review the plan and register there.

examples.title: Start cheaper, upgrade later
examples.customer_turn: Could I start smaller and change later if it works?
examples.final_candidate_response: You can start with $29 if [feature X] covers enough. If you later need [feature A] or [feature B], we can move you to $59.
